why: Variant 1 is the most performable: fragmented real-speech lines with genuine silence, the quotable delivered isolated and clean on its own beat, and a true continuous descent into sleep that never re-spikes — whereas 2 buries the quotable in banter and 3 crowds it inside a paragraph.
fixes: Cut the 'Natural talent. [chuckles]' joke and the '…no. You didn't ruin anything' exchange mid-descent — they re-engage the listener's brain right when energy should only be falling; fold the reassurance in earlier, before the quotable.

Trim the tail after '[slowly] Goodnight, sweetheart.' to a single closing beat ('Right here.') — the current triple ending ('Right here. / Still right here.') plus the earlier 'Almost there / Ahhhhh / Shh' stack is one landing too many.
